name: Blackstrap Provincial Park - Kevin Misfeldt and Sunset Ridge Campgrounds
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-19, Kevin Misfeldt + Sunset Ridge only: every paging row reads 'Near Water - no'. Esri World_Imagery z18 (0.37 m/px) with SKPP GIS points for 12 Kevin Misfeldt and 8 Sunset Ridge sites: Kevin Misfeldt's open-grass non-electric sites 254-257 lie 42-51 m from Blackstrap Lake's open water (reservoir: the vegetated edge is the high-water line), across about 10 m of mown grass and then a continuous band of shoreline willow and shrubs; 261 about 70 m back; 204 and 205 at the south-west corner about 35 m and more from the water through trees. SKPP site photos (read 2026-11-19): the lake shows over the shrub band from 253-256 and 259-261, through trees from 251; 204-206, 227-229, 239, 250, 252 and 257 show no lake. No site on open ground to the water. Sunset Ridge sits up the hill 300 m+ east of the shore, inland. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: ReserveAmerica SKPP parkId 290310, read 2026-11-19 (whole-park paging table, 147 rows, + 20 sampled detail pages): Kevin Misfeldt 62 (31 Nightly Electric 15/30 A, 30 Nightly Non-Electric incl. walk-ins 221-224, 1 Accessible Nightly Full Service 264A) + Sunset Ridge 63 (45 Nightly Electric + 1 Accessible Nightly Electric 15/30 A, 10 Nightly Full Service 317-326 at 15/30/50 A with water and sewer, 7 Seasonal Electric) = 125 site-specific sites, 118 by the night; maximum equipment 25-50 ft, every sampled site takes a 19-25 ft unit. Camp-Easy yurts 217-218 and the pavilion not counted. Hazelnut Grove (100-118) is now its own entry. --Claude
note: Provincial-park campgrounds near the south end of Blackstrap Lake, a reservoir southeast of Saskatoon: Kevin Misfeldt on the shore, part aspen woods and part open grass, and Sunset Ridge up the hill to the east. Hazelnut Grove, the park's winter-camping loop about 5 km north by the park entrance, has its own entry. 7 Sunset Ridge sites are seasonal. --Claude

season.note: 2026 dates. Full services May 14 to September 30; October camping on electric sites with pit and portable toilets, booked through the park. Winter camping is at Hazelnut Grove.

curation_note: Split 2026-11-19: this id kept Kevin Misfeldt + Sunset Ridge (125 sites), re-pinned from 51.7462,-106.4593 (a track in the gap between the two loops) onto Kevin Misfeldt's sites by site 200; Hazelnut Grove (sites 100-118, 19 electric) became a new entry, measured 5.34 km to Kevin Misfeldt and 5.01 km to Sunset Ridge centroid to centroid (nearest sampled sites 117 and 301, 4.79 km apart), on its own lakeshore spur by the Highway 211 park entrance. Kevin Misfeldt and Sunset Ridge are 0.44 km apart on one road, so they stay together. --Claude
